# IQVIA

> IQVIA transforms life sciences through integrated data, advanced AI technology, and human expertise to drive innovation in healthcare and pharmaceutical development.

IQVIA is a global leader in life sciences intelligence and clinical research services, combining real-world evidence, healthcare analytics, and AI-powered solutions to support pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare organizations. The company operates through regional offices worldwide, delivering localized expertise in clinical research, market insights, and healthcare innovation.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare-grade AI
- Real-world evidence
- Clinical research
- Life sciences
- IQVIA AI Assistant
- Healthcare analytics
- Pharmaceutical solutions
- Data intelligence
- Regional offices
- Healthcare consulting
- IQVIA Institute
- Industry partnerships
- LATAM operations
- Corporate innovation
- Healthcare services

## Core Platform & Solutions

- [IQVIA Homepage](https://www.iqvia.com): IQVIA's main platform showcasing life sciences innovation, AI solutions, healthcare-grade technology, and corporate overview of transforming healthcare through data and human science.

## Regional Offices & Locations

- [IQVIA Brasil](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/brazil): IQVIA Brasil office in São Paulo providing regional healthcare solutions, clinical research services, and pharmaceutical market insights for Latin America.
- [Canada](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/canada): IQVIA Canada location offering healthcare solutions and pharmaceutical market insights for North American operations.
- [Central America and Caribbean](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/central-america-and-caribbean): IQVIA Central America & Caribbean regional office serving healthcare innovation and life sciences consulting across the region.
- [France](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/france): IQVIA France providing life sciences solutions, healthcare innovation services, and clinical research support for European markets.
- [Nordics](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/nordics): IQVIA Nordics region serving Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Norway with healthcare analytics and real-world evidence services.
- [Adriatic](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/adriatic): IQVIA Adriatic region office covering Slovenia, Croatia, and Bosnia with healthcare consulting and clinical research capabilities.
- [Ecuador](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/ecuador): IQVIA Ecuador office in Quito providing regional healthcare services and life sciences consulting for Andean markets.
- [Belgium](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/belgium): IQVIA Belgium office providing healthcare analytics, real-world evidence, and clinical research services for Western Europe.
- [Bulgaria](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/bulgaria): IQVIA Bulgaria Sofia office specializing in clinical research, data science, and healthcare consulting services.
- [Romania](https://www.iqvia.com/locations/romania): IQVIA Romania Bucharest office offering healthcare consulting, clinical research, and life sciences solutions for Eastern Europe.
